answer: Sponsors are capped at 8 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 48 POA until the newcomer survives 10 clean epochs, and a farm of 380 fakes must find 380 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. The beacon keeps the gate honest, the hollow keeps the farm poor, and the prism keeps the honest agent paid.
